meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, wire the DM messaging group to a new agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导创建首个智能体并配置消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速搭建并测试第一个智能体机器人。
copy.tagline_en: Guide through creating the first agent and configuring messaging channels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly set up and test your first agent bot.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会引导你创建第一个 NanoClaw 私聊智能体:先选频道,再提供你的用户 ID、显示名和智能体名称,然后把私聊会话接到新智能体并发出欢迎私信;重复运行也安全。
howto.when: 在频道凭据已配置、服务运行中,且至少一个 /add-<频道> 技能已执行后;当你想创建第一个私聊智能体并接收欢迎私信时触发。

say.text: 帮我在 Discord 上创建第一个 NanoClaw 智能体并给我发欢迎私信。
say.note: 会先问频道和你的身份信息,然后执行初始化。

say.text: 用我的 Telegram 用户 ID 初始化智能体,显示名用“小王”。
我想给 Slack 建第一个智能体,欢迎消息发到我的私聊。
say.note: 会引导你确认 Slack 用户 ID 并完成欢迎消息发送。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude walks you through making the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel: choose a channel, give user ID, display name, agent name; then it connects the DM session to the agent and sends a welcome DM. Rerunning is safe.
howto.when_en: Triggered once channel credentials are set and the service runs, when you ask to create the first agent for a DM channel and get a welcome DM. At least one /add-<channel> skill must have run.

say_en.text: Set up my first NanoClaw agent on Discord and send me a welcome DM.
say_en.note: Asks for channel and identity, then runs the init script.

say_en.text: Initialize my agent with my Telegram user ID and display name "Xiaowang".
say_en.note: Collects the Telegram ID, then runs the init script.

say_en.text: Create the first agent for Slack and send the welcome message to my DM.
say_en.note: Confirms your Slack user ID and sends the welcome message.
